prompt:
Precise-object-edit. Animate the EXACT existing pixel character in IMAGE1, not a redesign. IMAGE1 is the EDIT TARGET: eight identical approved idle sprites, FOUR columns by TWO rows, on a transparent 4:3 canvas. IMAGE2 is a technical limb-motion guide fitted to that idle body's dimensions.
Keep every head and torso in the EXACT location, size, shape and pixel style shown in IMAGE1. Preserve the existing large hair/head silhouette, facial pixels (front view only), neck height, shoulder width, shirt length, tie/strap patterns, hip height, bag attachment, trouser thickness and original palette. Do not make a smaller head, shorter shirt, longer legs, narrower torso, larger shoes, detailed face or different hair texture. DO NOT shrink or reposition a character to match the guide. The rectangles in guide are protected HEAD/NECK and TORSO zones from the real idle model.
Edit ONLY the limb articulation needed to walk: arms counter-swing from the existing shoulders, legs bend from the existing hips. Preserve the existing head and torso pixels rather than drawing them again. Shirt starts at logical y24, hip/waist about y32-33, head/neck occupies y7-23, feet no lower than y45. Overall approved standing body height is39 logical pixels in a32x48 cell. All cells must retain identical margins/registration. No sheet-row padding drift.
Output eight complete sprites: contact A, closing A, passing A, opening A, contact B, closing B, passing B, opening B. 0..3 top row,4..7 bottom row. Thighs retain the original volume around4 logical px, calves3, hands3x3, shoes about4px wide; maintain width on foreshortened limbs. Passing poses bring the swing knee/foot close to the support leg; arms approach neutral and open again. Guide blue identifies anatomical LEFT limbs, dark identifies RIGHT: these are not costume colors. Use unchanged navy trousers and stable depth shading.
All sprites face UP/AWAY: preserve exactly the back of the approved head, no eyes. LEFT leg is screen LEFT, bag is screen RIGHT. Frame0 left leg steps up/shorter, right trails lower; left arm trails lower and right arm advances up. Frame2 left supports, right foot lifts and passes. Frame4 opposite contact. Head shape stays full width of the approved idle, not a narrow ball.
CRITICAL: This is modifying the existing idle body, NOT drawing a new illustration from a character reference. Preserve crisp native pixel blocks at the current logical pixel density, no antialiasing, no glow, no gradients or increased detail. Transparent background, no diagrams, rectangles, labels, borders, extra figures or ground shadows. Same FOUR by TWO layout and4:3 canvas as edit target.
